title: App Icon Lab
summary: Differentiate the TTS launcher icon from the marmalade agent app icon (identical jar + orange field). 9 mark variants x 5 background fields.
decision: V5-e5 on B0: jar lower-left with rounded-corner flat-top :D grin (no tongue, no orange-slice decoration), cream speech bubble with amber waveform, on the existing #F97316 field. Shipped to ic_launcher_foreground.xml, play-assets/icon-512.png, and fastlane icon. Runner-up: V2 sound waves.
